notes.title: Reintroducing the Golden Panda Trophy Event
notes.content:
Dear Valued Players,

I am excited to share some fantastic news with you all. Since the release of Bao Bao's Cozy Laundromat, over 5,000 players have joined our cozy community. Your overwhelming support and enthusiasm have been truly inspiring, and I extend my heartfelt gratitude to each of you.​

To celebrate our growing family, I am reintroducing the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3194550/view/533215604137526127]Golden Panda Trophy[/url] event. This limited-time event will run from [b]March 31st, 2025, to April 7th, 2025[/b].​

[h2]Enhancements to the Golden Panda Trophy:[/h2]

In response to your valuable feedback, the Golden Panda Trophy now offers an additional perk. Once the event goes live, this exclusive item will generate [b]10 gold coins per minute[/b], providing even more benefits to your laundromat.​

[h2]Conclusion of the St. Patrick’s Day Event:[/h2]

Please note that the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3194550/view/518582081927774341]St. Patrick’s Day Event[/url] will conclude on [b]March 31st, 2025[/b], coinciding with the launch of the Golden Panda Trophy event. If you haven't yet collected the special in-game items from the St. Patrick’s event, now is the perfect time to do so before they are retired.​

Your continuous feedback and support have been instrumental in shaping the game. I am committed to enhancing your gaming experience and look forward to bringing you more exciting updates in the future.

Thank you once again for being an integral part of the Bao Bao's Cozy Laundromat community.

Warm regards,

Prateek /Destroyer Doggo
Developer, Bao Bao's Cozy Laundromat

notes.title: v0.0.0.72: New Feature Update – Focus Timer & St. Patrick’s Day Event!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I hope you're all doing well and enjoying the game! Today, I’m excited to introduce a new feature based on a player suggestion. A while ago, someone asked if I could add a Focus Timer to help them study while running Bao Bao’s Cozy Laundromat in the background. Well, it’s here!

You can now enable or disable the Focus Timer from the settings menu. If you have any feedback or suggestions for improvements, I’d love to hear them!

This update also brings St. Patrick’s Day limited-time event items! You can read more about the event here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3194550/view/518582081927774341]Steam News[/url].

I hope these updates make the game even better for you.

Happy playing!
Prateek / Destroyer Doggo

notes.title: Golden Panda Trophy – A Limited-Time Event for True Fans!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

A rare and exclusive item, the [b]Golden Panda Trophy[/b], will be available [b]from March 3rd, 12:30 PM IST to March 6th, 12:30 PM IST[/b]. If you've been grinding hard and maxing out your in-game earnings, this is the perfect way to showcase your dedication!

[h3]Important Details About This Item:[/h3]
[list]
[*]  [b]A rare and prestigious decorative item[/b] for the most dedicated players of [u]Bao Bao's Cozy Laundromat[/u]!
[*]  [b]Available only in the demo[/b] for players who have earned [b]100k gold coins[/b]—celebrate your success with this exclusive golden panda!
[*]  [b]Limited-time only![/b] This item will [b]disappear forever[/b] after [b]March 6th, 12:30 PM IST[/b]—don’t miss out!
[*]  [b]Carries over to the full game[/b]—your demo save file will transfer this trophy to the final release!
[/list]

Don’t miss your chance to grab this special item and show off your achievements!

notes.title: The Wait Is Almost Over: Bao Bao’s Cozy Laundromat Demo Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

Thank you so much for following Bao Bao’s Cozy Laundromat on Steam and supporting the game throughout its development journey. I’m thrilled to share that the development is finally complete! 🎉

While I’m eager to launch the game, I’m dedicating a bit more time to thorough playtesting to ensure a polished experience, free from any bugs or major issues.

I also have an exciting update to share: the demo launch date! 🎮 Although the demo is a smaller slice of the full game, it offers a great glimpse into the cozy world of Bao Bao’s Cozy Laundromat.

Here’s what you can expect in the demo:

[list]
[*] 6 washing machines and 6 dryers to manage.
[*] A few plants to decorate your space.
[*] Access to Twitch chat functionalities for streamers.
[*] Note: The ability to buy extra pandas or cats will not be available in the demo.
[/list]

[b]Demo Release Date:[/b] 15th January 2015
[b]Time:[/b] 12:30 PM IST

Thank you once again for your enthusiasm and support for this project—it means the world to me!

Warm regards,
Prateek
Destroyer Doggo
